pms.title: Import from your PMS

beds24.title: Get an invite code in Beds24
beds24.one: In Beds24, open Settings → Marketplace → API.
beds24.two: Create an invite code with read-only access to properties, bookings, and guest names (read:properties, read:bookings, read:bookings-personal).
beds24.three: Copy the code and paste it below. It works once, within 24 hours.

hostex.title: Get an access token in Hostex
hostex.one: In Hostex, open Settings → OpenAPI. It needs the Pro edition.
hostex.two: Create an access token with the read-only scope.
hostex.three: Copy the token and paste it below.

publish.changed: The guide changed while you were reviewing. Check it again before publishing.

versions.title: Published versions
versions.intro: The latest 20 versions are kept. Restoring one makes it your draft; nothing changes for guests until you publish.
versions.empty: You haven't published this guide yet.
versions.restoreConfirm: Your current draft will be replaced with version {number}. Continue?
versions.restored: You restored version {number} as the draft. Publish when it's ready.

preview.title: Preview
preview.intro: This is how guests will see the guide. Locked fields show as placeholders.
preview.empty: This section has no reviewed content yet.

interview.title: Interview
interview.intro: We ask one question at a time about what guests ask most. We draft the text and you review it.
interview.reminder: Don't include codes or passwords in your answers: keep them in a locked field.
interview.micDenied: We couldn't use the microphone. Type your answer.
interview.done: We added {count, plural, one {# text} other {# texts}} to {section} for you to review.
interview.redacted: We removed a code from your answer. Keep it in a locked field.
interview.error_not_understood: We didn't understand the answer. Try again or say it another way.
interview.error_transcription_failed: We couldn't transcribe the voice note. Type your answer.
interview.error_unsupported_type: We couldn't read the voice note. Type your answer.
interview.error_ai_unavailable: The assistant isn't available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
interview.lockedTopic: This answer is a code. Keep it in a locked field, not in the text.
interview.noMore: Done! There are no more questions for now.
interview.busyElsewhere: Someone else has an interview open on this guide. You can continue it here.

translations.title: Translations
translations.intro: Every text is translated by itself. Review the translations and fix what's needed; the ones you review don't change without you.
translations.singleLanguage: This guide is in one language. Add another language in the property's details to translate it.
translations.empty: This section has no texts yet.
translations.state_out_of_date: Out of date: the original changed
translations.reason_ai_limit: the daily AI limit was reached; it continues tomorrow
translations.reason_ai_unavailable: the assistant isn't available; we'll try again
translations.changed: The section changed. Reload to see the latest.

uploads.title: Manuals and photos
uploads.intro: Upload PDF manuals or photos of appliances, the entrance, or instructions. We read the text, delete the file, and suggest content for you to review.
uploads.reminder: Don't upload photos of codes or passwords: keep them in a locked field.
uploads.limit: Up to 10 files at a time: PDFs up to 20 MB or photos up to 10 MB.
uploads.status_done: {count, plural, =0 {Done} one {Done: # suggestion to review} other {Done: # suggestions to review}}
uploads.redacted: We removed {count, plural, one {a code} other {# codes}} from the text we read.
uploads.reason_too_many_pages: The PDF has more than 60 pages.
uploads.reason_password_protected: The PDF has a password. Remove it and upload it again.
uploads.reason_malware: The file didn't pass the security check.
uploads.reason_nothing_found: We didn't find useful information for the guide.
uploads.reason_ai_limit: You reached the daily AI limit. Upload it again tomorrow.
uploads.reason_ai_unavailable: The assistant isn't available. Try again later.
uploads.addToSection: Add this photo to a section
uploads.photoUnreadable: We couldn't open the photo {name}. Try another photo.

shared.overridden: You use your own copy of “{name}”.
shared.behind: The shared version changed since you made your copy.
shared.resetConfirm: Your copy of “{name}” will be replaced with the shared version. Continue?

sharedContent.title: Shared content
sharedContent.intro: Write once what repeats across your properties (policies, emergency contacts, checkout steps, area recommendations). Every guide inherits it; you can override or exclude it per property.
sharedContent.name: Block name
sharedContent.limit: You can have up to {limit} blocks.
sharedContent.empty: You don't have shared content yet.
sharedContent.noLocked: Locked fields belong to each property: they can't be used in shared content.
sharedContent.published: Published. {count, plural, =0 {Guides update when they are published} one {# published guide will update} other {# published guides will update}}.
sharedContent.deleteConfirm: It will be removed from every guide, published ones too. Delete?
sharedContent.changed: The block changed. Reload to see the latest.

share.title: Share the {property} guide
share.intro: Send the guide to your guests and download the QR code for the house.
share.reminder: Keep your check-in instructions in your platform messages too. The guide is optional for guests.
share.notPublished: Publish the guide to share it. Guests only see the published version.

propertyLink.title: Property link
propertyLink.body: Shows public content only. Codes stay locked.
propertyLink.opens: {count, plural, =0 {No opens in the last 30 days} one {Opened # time in the last 30 days} other {Opened # times in the last 30 days}}

qr.title: QR code
qr.body: To print and place in the house. It opens the public guide, never the codes.

regenerate.confirm: The current link and printed QR codes will stop working. Create a new link?
regenerate.done: Done: the new link works and the old one stopped working.

template.title: Scheduled message for every booking
template.body: Paste it into your platform's scheduled messages, set to send when the booking is confirmed. It carries the property link, never codes.
template.airbnb: Airbnb: Messages → Scheduled messages → Create. Send: when the booking is confirmed.
template.booking: Booking.com: Messages → Message templates → Schedule after confirmation.
template.vrbo: Vrbo: Inbox → Scheduled messages → After booking.

poster.title: Scan to see the house guide
poster.public: Opens the public guide. Your access details are in your booking messages.
poster.hint: Use Letter or A4. The network name is not saved.

stays.title: Stays: links that show the codes
stays.body: Each stay has its own link. It shows the codes only from the check-in day until 2 hours after checkout. Send it in that booking's chat.
stays.empty: No upcoming stays. Connect your calendar or add a stay by hand on the property.
stays.regenerateConfirm: The current link will stop working on every device. Create a new one?
stays.revokeConfirm: The link will stop showing the codes right away. Revoke it?
stays.devices: {count, plural, =0 {Not opened yet} one {Opened on # device} other {Opened on # devices}}
stays.valuesShown: {count, plural, =0 {Codes not viewed} one {Codes viewed # time} other {Codes viewed # times}}
stays.locked: Verification paused until {time} after failed tries.

confirmation.title: Confirmation code
confirmation.body: Ask guests for a 6-character code before showing access codes. Each stay gets its own code, shown next to its link and in the stay message.
confirmation.on: Guests must enter their stay's code the first time.
confirmation.off: The stay link alone shows the codes during the stay.

message.title: Message for the booking chat
message.body: It has the stay link, times, address, and the published arrival steps. Using the guide is optional for the guest: this message carries the essentials.

conversations.title: Conversations at {property}
conversations.intro: What guests ask in the guide's chat. The ones that need you come first.
conversations.empty: No conversations yet. They appear when a guest writes in the guide's chat.

reasons.not_confident: The assistant couldn't answer from the guide

conversations.emergencyCard: Emergency card shown to the guest

draft.title: Assistant's draft
draft.body: The guest got a holding reply. Review the draft and send it, edit it, or write your own reply.

reply.title: Reply
reply.label: Your reply
reply.hint: The guest sees it in the guide's chat with your name.

warnings.title: Check your reply
warnings.intro: Your text may break these rules:
warnings.links: It has links that aren't in the guide.
warnings.promises: It promises a refund, discount, or change.
warnings.off_platform: It asks to book or pay off the platform.
warnings.lockedNote: If you share a code, the stay link is the safer way.

decisions.held: Handed the conversation to the host
decisions.pointer: Pointed to the locked value's section

checkNames.codes: No codes that aren't in the guide
checkNames.promises: No promises of refunds, discounts, or changes
checkNames.off_platform: Doesn't ask to book or pay off the platform

levels.auto: answer when it's in the guide
levels.full_auto: answer and ask on its own

conversations.readOnly: Your role can see this conversation but not reply.

assistant.title: Chat assistant
assistant.workspaceBody: These settings apply to every property in the workspace, except those with their own.
assistant.propertyBody: Each group can use the workspace settings or have its own for this property.

autonomy.title: When it answers on its own
autonomy.body: For each topic, choose whether the assistant prepares a draft for your team or answers on its own.

levels.auto: Answer when it's in the guide
levels.full_auto: Answer and ask on its own

help.draft: Your team approves every reply before it reaches the guest.
help.auto: Sends only replies that cite the guide and pass the checks; the rest arrives as a draft.
help.full_auto: It can also ask one clarifying question and give general information about the destination, always with the checks.

lockedItems.codes: Requests for codes and passwords (it points to the guide section)
lockedItems.not_confident: Anything the assistant isn't sure about

tone.title: Tone
tone.body: How the assistant writes to guests, including holding replies.
tone.formal: Formal, without exclamation marks or emoji

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.body: During these hours, alerts that aren't urgent wait and reach you together when they end. Emergencies and malfunctions are sent at once. Guests are told when you usually reply.
quiet.zoneWorkspace: They apply in each property's time zone.
quiet.noZone: This property has no time zone. Add it in the property details to use quiet hours.
quiet.same: Start and end must be different.

contacts.title: Who to alert
contacts.body: Who gets the email when a conversation needs your team.
contacts.all: Everyone on the team who handles conversations
contacts.emergencyNote: Emergencies always reach owners and admins too.
contacts.chosen: {count, plural, one {# person chosen} other {# people chosen}}

instructions.title: Instructions for the assistant
instructions.body: Style preferences or what to highlight. They don't change the rules: emergencies, payments, and reservation changes always go to your team, and codes are only shown in the guide.
instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.placeholder: For example: Suggest walking to the beach; parking there is hard.
instructions.propertyNote: They add to the workspace's instructions.

issues.restricted_value: They seem to contain a code or a password. Codes are only shown in the guide to verified guests.
issues.off_platform: They ask guests to book or pay outside the platform.

assistant.conflict: Someone changed these settings while you were editing. We loaded the current values; review them and save again.
assistant.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.

summary.automatic: {count, plural, =0 {No topic is answered on its own} one {# topic is answered on its own} other {# topics are answered on their own}}
summary.own: This property has its own settings.

test.title: Test the assistant
test.body: Write a question the way a guest would. You'll see what would happen with the saved settings; nobody receives anything. Each test counts toward the daily limit.
test.label: Question

outcomes.sent: Would be sent to the guest

test.timeout: The test is taking longer than usual. Try again in a moment.
test.paused: You ran many tests. Try again in {minutes} min.
test.notPublished: Publish the guide to test the assistant.
